  budget: { budget:1, mid:1, premium:1 },

function answersToQueryString() {
  if (!answers.budget || !answers.season || !answers.vibe || !answers.walking) return '';
  var parts = [
    'r=1',
    'b=' + encodeURIComponent(answers.budget),
    's=' + encodeURIComponent(answers.season),
    'v=' + encodeURIComponent(answers.vibe),
    'w=' + encodeURIComponent(answers.walking)
  ];
  if (answers.ages.length) parts.push('a=' + answers.ages.map(encodeURIComponent).join(','));
  if (answers.interests.length) parts.push('i=' + answers.interests.map(encodeURIComponent).join(','));
  return parts.join('&');
}

function parseQueryToAnswers(search) {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(search.charAt(0) === '?' ? search.slice(1) : search);
  if (params.get('subscribed') === '1' && params.get('r') !== '1') return null;
  if (params.get('r') !== '1') return null;
  var b = params.get('b');
  var s = params.get('s');
  var v = params.get('v');
  var w = params.get('w');
  if (!QUIZ_VALID.budget[b] || !QUIZ_VALID.season[s] || !QUIZ_VALID.vibe[v] || !QUIZ_VALID.walking[w]) return null;
  function safeDec(x) {
    try { return decodeURIComponent(x.trim()); } catch (e) { return x.trim(); }
  }
  var ages = (params.get('a') || '').split(',').map(safeDec).filter(function(x) { return x && QUIZ_VALID.age[x]; });
  var interests = (params.get('i') || '').split(',').map(safeDec).filter(function(x) { return x && QUIZ_VALID.interest[x]; });
  return { budget:b, season:s, vibe:v, walking:w, ages:ages, interests:interests };
}

    if (i > 0) {

    if (step === 4) return answers.ages.length > 0;
    if (step === 5) return answers.interests.length > 0;
  }
  var keys = ['budget','season','vibe','walking'];
  return answers[keys[step]] !== null;
}

  if (!btn) return;
  if (stepHasAnswer(step)) btn.classList.add('enabled');
  else btn.classList.remove('enabled');
}

document.querySelectorAll('.question-card').forEach(function(card) {
  var step = parseInt(card.dataset.step);
  var isMulti = MULTI_STEPS.indexOf(step) !== -1;
  card.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(function(pill) {
    pill.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (isMulti) {
        if (step === 4) {
          var pv = pill.dataset.value;
          if (pv === 'adults_only') {
            card.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('selected'); });

            answers.ages = ['adults_only'];
          } else {
            var adultsPill = card.querySelector('[data-value="adults_only"]');
            if (adultsPill) adultsPill.classList.remove('selected');

            answers.ages = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.pill.selected')).map(function(p) { return p.dataset.value; });
          }
          syncAllPillAria();
        } else {

          answers.interests = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.pill.selected')).map(function(p) { return p.dataset.value; });
          updateQ5SoftHint();
        }
      } else {
        card.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('selected'); });
        pill.classList.add('selected');
        var keys = ['budget','season','vibe','walking'];
        answers[keys[step]] = pill.dataset.value;
      }
      updateNext(step);
      syncAllPillAria();
    });
  });
});

/* ── Navigation ── */
function goNext(step) {
  if (!stepHasAnswer(step)) return;
  if (step === TOTAL_STEPS - 1) {
    if (window.plausible) plausible('Quiz-Finish-Click', { props: { question: String(step + 1) } });
    var overlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
    var bar = document.getElementById('loadingBarFill');
    var loadMs = (typeof window.matchMedia !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) ? 400 : 900;
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    bar.style.removeProperty('transition');
    bar.style.width = '0%';
    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() { bar.style.width = '100%'; });
    });
    setTimeout(function() {
      overlay.classList.remove('active');
      bar.style.transition = 'none';
      bar.style.width = '0%';
      showResults();
    }, loadMs);
    return;
  }
  if (window.plausible) plausible('Quiz-Step-Next', { props: { from_step: String(step + 1), to_step: String(step + 2) } });
  currentStep = step + 1;
  showStep(currentStep);
}

function goBack(step) {
  if (step === 0) return;
  currentStep = step - 1;
  showStep(currentStep);
}

for (var s = 0; s < TOTAL_STEPS; s++) {
  (function(step) {
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById('next' + step);
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goNext(step); });
    var backBtn = document.getElementById('back' + step);

  })(s);
}

/* ── Scoring ── */
function score(dest) {
  var pts = 0;
  var max = 0;

  // Budget (0-4)
  max += 4;
  if (dest.budget.indexOf(answers.budget) !== -1) pts += 4;
  else if ((answers.budget === 'budget' && dest.budget.indexOf('mid') !== -1) ||
           (answers.budget === 'premium' && dest.budget.indexOf('mid') !== -1)) pts += 2;

  // Season (0-4)
  max += 4;
  if (dest.goodSeasons.indexOf(answers.season) !== -1) pts += 4;
  else if (dest.okSeasons.indexOf(answers.season) !== -1) pts += 2;
  else pts -= 2;

  // Vibe (0-4)
  max += 4;
  if (dest.vibes.indexOf(answers.vibe) !== -1) pts += 4;
  else if (answers.vibe === 'mix') pts += 2; // mix always partial match

  // Walking (0-3): exact=3, adjacent=1, opposite=0
  max += 3;
  if (dest.walking === answers.walking) pts += 3;
  else if ((dest.walking === 'medium') ||
           (dest.walking === 'low' && answers.walking === 'medium') ||
           (dest.walking === 'high' && answers.walking === 'medium')) pts += 1;

  // Ages (0-3)
  max += 3;
  var hasBabyOrYoung = answers.ages.indexOf('baby') !== -1 || answers.ages.indexOf('young') !== -1;
  if (hasBabyOrYoung && dest.hardForBaby) pts -= 2;
  else if (dest.allAges) pts += 3;
  else pts += 2;

  // Interests (0-3 per interest, up to 6)
  var interestCount = (answers.interests && answers.interests.length) ? answers.interests.length : 0;
  var matchInterests = (answers.interests || []).filter(function(i) { return dest.interests.indexOf(i) !== -1; });
  max += Math.max(interestCount * 2, 4);
  pts += matchInterests.length * 2;

  var pct = Math.round((pts / max) * 100);
  return Math.min(Math.max(pct, 20), 99);
}

/* ── Generate personalized bullets (dedupe near-identical lines) ── */
function getBullets(dest) {
  var bullets = [];
  function prefixKey(s) {
    s = (s || '').trim();
    return s.slice(0, 32).replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }
  function isDup(line) {
    if (!line || !line.trim()) return true;
    var p = prefixKey(line);
    for (var i = 0; i < bullets.length; i++) {
      var q = prefixKey(bullets[i]);
      if (line === bullets[i]) return true;
      if (p.length >= 14 && q.length >= 14 && (p === q || line.indexOf(q.slice(0, 18)) === 0 || bullets[i].indexOf(p.slice(0, 18)) === 0))
        return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  answers.interests.forEach(function(interest) {
    var line = dest.bullets[interest];
    if (line && !isDup(line)) bullets.push(line);
  });
  dest.bullets.default.forEach(function(b) {
    if (bullets.length < 3 && !isDup(b)) bullets.push(b);
  });
  if (bullets.length === 0 && dest.bullets.default && dest.bullets.default.length) {
    bullets = dest.bullets.default.slice(0, 3);
  }
  return bullets.slice(0, 3);
}

function getMatchReason(d) {
  var parts = [];
  var budgetMap = { budget:'תקציב חסכוני', mid:'תקציב בינוני', premium:'פרמיום' };
  var seasonMap = { spring:'אביב', summer:'קיץ', fall:'סתיו', winter:'חורף' };
  if (answers.budget && d.budget.indexOf(answers.budget) !== -1)
    parts.push('מתאים ל' + budgetMap[answers.budget] + ' שלכם');
  if (answers.season && d.goodSeasons.indexOf(answers.season) !== -1)
    parts.push('עונת ה' + seasonMap[answers.season] + ' אידיאלית שם');
  var matchInterests = (answers.interests || []).filter(function(i) { return d.interests.indexOf(i) !== -1; });
  if (matchInterests.length >= 2)
    parts.push('מתאים לתחומי העניין שבחרתם');
  if (answers.vibe && d.vibes.indexOf(answers.vibe) !== -1 && parts.length < 2)

  if (parts.length === 0) parts.push('מגוון אטרקציות לכל טיפוס מטייל');
  return '✨ ' + parts.slice(0, 2).join(' · ');
}
